lessons.trigger_condition: V412 safely added six TCG categories, but purchase/release coverage and dashboard validation still retained core-three assumptions, and promoted categories lacked a bounded periodic official/market source monitor. V413 therefore moves market/release/promo/purchase coverage to the declarative registry, adds Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and Digimon Card Game as verified promoted categories, keeps Flesh and Blood TCG, Weiß Schwarz, Cardfight!! Vanguard and hololive OCG watch-only, and integrates a public-HTTPS bounded source-health monitor without changing grading calibration or neural architecture.
lessons.prevention_rule: Drive tablet market, release, promo and purchase coverage from the validated declarative registry; monitor promoted non-core official and market URLs with bounded public-HTTPS requests after mandatory collection; preserve previous verified evidence on outages; feed only non-directional source-health/catalog-depth/rarity attention into the existing market lens. Promote only verified categories meeting official, independent-market, depth and activation gates. Keep grading false until separate calibration, preserve the eight mandatory collectors and 17→12→18 screen neural, and forbid profit/price-direction prediction, stock invention, runtime source rewrite, arbitrary commands and Git/main self-write.

lessons.safety_boundary: V413 expands verified declarative market categories and removes remaining core-three UI/purchase assumptions. It does not guarantee profit, predict future prices, auto-enable grading for uncalibrated games, execute arbitrary generated code, rewrite runtime source autonomously, write Git/main, or treat repository tests as proof of physical Lenovo execution.
